aggregate.algorithm: sha256 over UTF-8 of json.dumps([{path,bytes,lf,sha256} for index.html,styles.css,app.js in fixed order], sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')); object keys sorted, no spaces, no trailing newline; per-file sha256 is over raw bytes and bytes+sha256 are inputs, so the aggregate is byte-sensitive; index.html is CRLF and its CR bytes are part of its raw hash; the CR count is informational and is not a normalization input.
aggregate.crlf_note: index.html has 34 CR bytes (CRLF); raw-byte sha256 and byte count are part of the aggregate, therefore CRLF is part of the aggregate input and is not normalized away.
